enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Close eyes. Remain lying on the bed with head on the pillow. Turn from side to side under the blanket. Keep eyes closed with breathing steady. Remain asleep for the full period.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth, getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Swing legs off the bed. Stand up. Walk from Bedroom 1 to the Bathroom. Turn on the Bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Cup hands under the water. Splash water on the face. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel back on the rack. Pick up the toothbrush. Turn on the tap. Wet the toothbrush under the water. Turn off the tap. Squeeze toothpaste from the tube onto the toothbrush. Put the tube down. Brush teeth with the toothbrush. Rinse the mouth with water from the cup. Spit into the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the toothbrush. Turn off the tap. Put the toothbrush back in the holder. Walk to the bedroom. Open the wardrobe. Take out the work clothes. Take off the sleepwear. Put on the shirt. Put on the trousers. Put on the socks. Walk out of Bedroom 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and toasting bread
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Kitchen. Turn on the Kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk and the bread. Close the refrigerator door. Put the bread on the counter. Open the bread bag. Take out two slices of bread. Put the slices into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Pick up the kettle. Walk to the sink. Turn on the tap. Fill the kettle with water. Turn off the tap. Walk back to the counter. Put the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Open the cupboard. Take out a mug. Put the mug on the counter. Take out a plate. Wait beside the counter. Pick up the mug. Pour milk from the carton into the mug. Put the carton back into the refrigerator. The toaster pops the bread up. Pick up the toast with fingers. Put the toast on the plate. Pick up a knife. Spread butter on the toast. Put the knife down. Sit down at the table. Pick up the toast. Take bites of the toast. Lift the mug. Drink the milk. Put the mug down. Stand up. The kettle switches off. Pick up the kettle. Pour hot water into a cup. Put the kettle back on its base. Pick up the cup. Blow on the hot water. Sip the water.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking the weather forecast and storm warning on the phone, packing work bag and uniform
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Pick up the Phone from the bedside table. Unlock the Phone with the finger. Tap the weather app icon. Scroll down the forecast screen. Tap the storm warning notification. Read the warning text on the screen. Press the side button to lock the Phone. Put the Phone down on the bed. Open the wardrobe door. Take out the work bag. Put the bag on the bed. Open the bag zipper. Take the folded uniform from the shelf. Put the uniform into the bag. Take the stethoscope from the desk. Put the stethoscope into the bag. Take the badge from the desk. Clip the badge onto the bag strap. Take the water bottle from the desk. Put the water bottle into the bag side pocket. Close the bag zipper. Pick up the Phone from the bed. Put the Phone into the coat pocket. Pick up the bag by the handle. Walk out of Bedroom 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the front door. Close the door. Lock the door with the key. Put the key into the bag. Walk along the path to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the Phone out of the pocket. Check the bus arrival time on the screen. Put the Phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Tap the travel card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit down on the seat. Hold the bag on the lap. Stand up at the stop. Walk to the bus door. Step off the bus. Walk along the pavement to the hospital entrance. Push the hospital entrance door open. Walk into the hospital corridor. Walk to the locker room. Open the locker. Take off the coat. Hang the coat in the locker. Take the uniform out of the bag. Put on the uniform. Put the bag into the locker. Close the locker. Walk to the ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional: morning patient rounds, medication administration and clinical documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the nurses' station. Pick up the patient list clipboard. Walk to the first patient room. Knock on the door. Open the door. Walk to the bedside. Greet the patient. Ask the patient how the night was. Take the blood pressure cuff. Wrap the cuff around the patient's arm. Press the start button on the monitor. Read the blood pressure value on the screen. Remove the cuff. Place the cuff back on the trolley. Pick up the thermometer. Place the thermometer under the patient's tongue. Remove the thermometer. Read the temperature value. Record the values on the chart. Pick up the pen. Write the readings on the clipboard. Put the pen down. Walk to the next patient room. Repeat the rounds. Walk to the medication room. Open the medication cabinet. Take out the medication cups. Check the labels against the medication chart. Fill the cups with the tablets. Place the cups onto the trolley. Push the trolley to the patient rooms. Hand the medication cup to the patient. Offer a cup of water. Watch the patient swallow the tablets. Walk back to the nurses' station. Sit down at the computer. Type the patient notes into the clinical system. Press the save button. Pick up the Phone. Call the doctor for a handover. Speak into the Phone. End the call. Put the Phone down.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital staff room
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the staff room. Push the staff room door open. Walk to the table. Pull out a chair. Sit down on the chair. Open the bag. Take out the lunch box. Open the lunch box lid. Pick up the fork. Eat the food from the lunch box. Put the fork down. Pick up the water bottle. Open the bottle cap. Drink the water. Close the bottle cap. Put the water bottle down. Close the lunch box lid. Stand up. Push the chair back under the table. Walk to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the lunch box. Turn off the tap. Put the lunch box into the bag. Walk out of the staff room.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical work: patient assessments, handover meetings and care coordination
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the ward corridor. Pick up the assessment form. Walk to the patient room. Knock on the door. Open the door. Walk to the bedside. Ask the patient about the pain level. Write the answers on the form. Check the IV line. Adjust the IV drip rate dial. Check the wound dressing. Remove the old dressing. Clean the wound with a gauze swab. Place a new dressing over the wound. Press the edges of the dressing down. Dispose of the old dressing in the bin. Wash hands at the sink. Turn off the tap. Dry hands with paper towel. Walk to the meeting room. Sit down at the table. Open the laptop. Take notes during the handover meeting. Speak to the colleagues about the patient care plan. Close the laptop. Stand up. Walk back to the ward. Push the medicine trolley to the next patient. Assist the patient to sit up in bed. Help the patient walk to the chair. Record the mobility progress on the chart. Walk to the nurses' station. Update the care coordination board. Tick the completed tasks on the list.

Walk to the locker room. Open the locker. Take off the uniform. Put on the coat. Take the bag out of the locker. Close the locker. Walk out of the hospital. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the Phone out of the pocket. Check the bus arrival time on the screen. Put the Phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Tap the travel card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit down on the seat. Hold the bag on the lap. Stand up at the stop. Walk to the bus door. Step off the bus. Walk along the pavement to the house. Take the key out of the bag. Insert the key into the lock. Turn the key. Push the front door open. Walk inside. Close the door. Lock the door. Put the key back into the bag.

Walk into the Kitchen. Turn on the Kitchen light. Put the bag down on the chair. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables and the chicken. Close the refrigerator door. Put the items on the counter. Turn on the tap. Rinse the vegetables under the water. Turn off the tap. Put the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables into pieces. Put the knife down. Pick up the pan. Put the pan on the InductionCooker. Press the InductionCooker power button. Press the heat setting button. Pour oil into the pan. Put the chicken into the pan. Turn the chicken with the spatula. Add the vegetables into the pan. Stir the food with the spatula. Press the InductionCooker power button off. Pick up a plate from the cupboard. Scoop the food onto the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Pull out a chair. Sit down. Pick up the fork. Eat the food from the plate. Put the fork down. Pick up the glass. Drink the water. Put the glass down.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the chair. Pick up the plate. Carry the plate to the sink. Pick up the fork. Carry the fork to the sink. Put the plate and fork into the sink. Pick up the glass. Put the glass into the sink. Wipe the table with the cloth. Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the lower rack. Pick up the plate from the sink. Place the plate into the rack. Place the fork into the cutlery basket. Place the glass into the upper rack. Push the lower rack in. Push the upper rack in. Pick up the detergent pod. Place the pod into the detergent compartment. Close the compartment lid. Close the dishwasher door. Press the start button on the dishwasher. Turn on the tap. Rinse the sink with water. Turn off the tap. Wipe the counter with the cloth. Wipe hands on the towel. Turn off the Kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Putting a load of laundry in the washing machine and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Bathroom. Turn on the Bathroom light. Open the laundry basket lid. Pick up the dirty clothes. Open the WashingMachine door. Put the clothes into the drum. Close the WashingMachine door. Open the detergent drawer. Pour detergent into the drawer. Close the detergent drawer. Press the power button on the WashingMachine. Press the program selection button. Press the start button. Turn on the WaterHeater switch. Take off the clothes. Put the clothes into the laundry basket. Open the shower door. Step into the shower. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the water temperature handle. Stand under the water. Wet the hair. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Put the bottle down. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the body. Put the soap down. Rinse the body under the water. Turn off the shower tap. Open the shower door. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Dry the body with the towel. Dry the hair with the towel. Hang the towel on the hook. Put on the clean clothes. Turn off the WaterHeater switch.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing for the severe storm: charging the phone, checking emergency supplies and locating a torch
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Living Room. Turn on the Living Room light. Pick up the Phone. Walk to the socket. Plug the charging cable into the Phone. Plug the cable into the wall socket. Put the Phone down on the table. Open the storage cupboard. Take out the emergency kit box. Put the box on the floor. Open the box lid. Take out the first aid kit. Check the contents of the first aid kit. Put the first aid kit back into the box. Take out the batteries. Check the battery expiry dates. Put the batteries back into the box. Take out the torch. Press the torch switch. Shine the torch at the wall. Press the torch switch off. Put the torch on the table. Take out the candles. Put the candles on the table. Take out the matches. Put the matches on the table. Close the box lid. Put the box back into the cupboard. Close the cupboard door. Open the kitchen cupboard. Take out the bottled water. Carry the bottles to the Living Room. Put the bottles on the table. Take the Phone off the cable. Check the battery level on the screen. Plug the Phone back into the cable.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the sofa. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the TV remote control from the table. Press the power button on the remote. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Put the remote down on the sofa cushion. Lean back on the sofa. Pick up the Phone. Unlock the Phone. Scroll the screen. Put the Phone down on the cushion. Pick up the remote. Press the volume button to raise the volume. Put the remote down. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the remote. Press the channel button to change the channel. Put the remote down. Sit upright. Reach for the glass on the table. Pick up the glass. Drink the water. Put the glass down. Lean back on the sofa. Watch the TV screen. Pick up the remote. Press the power button off.

enriched_activities.activity: Night-time hygiene routine and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the sofa. Walk to the Bathroom. Turn on the Bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Wet the toothbrush under the water. Turn off the tap. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Put the tube down. Brush teeth with the toothbrush. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the toothbrush. Turn off the tap. Put the toothbrush back into the holder. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel on the hook. Open the medicine cabinet. Take out the moisturizer. Open the lid. Squeeze cream onto the fingers. Apply the cream to the face. Close the lid. Put the moisturizer back into the cabinet. Close the cabinet door. Walk to the WashingMachine. Open the WashingMachine door. Take out the wet clothes. Put the clothes into the ClothesDryer. Close the ClothesDryer door. Press the ClothesDryer start button. Turn off the Bathroom light. Walk out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading on the phone under the desk lamp and winding down
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Turn on the DeskLamp. Pick up the Phone from the pocket. Sit down on the bed. Unlock the Phone with the finger. Tap the reading app icon. Scroll the article on the screen. Read the text on the screen. Swipe to the next page. Continue reading. Press the side button to lock the Phone. Put the Phone down on the bedside table. Stand up. Pull back the blanket. Turn off the DeskLamp. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Close eyes.
Lie down on the bed. Close eyes. Remain lying on the bed with head on the pillow. Turn from side to side under the blanket. Keep eyes closed with breathing steady. Remain asleep for the full period.
